teaser: A duffel half-packed by the door. A calendar with every square filled in anyway. You are a life path 5, an ESTP, and these two rarely feel like a stretch to hold together — a path built on freedom meeting a temperament built on nerve. What is particular here is the speed: the path and the type move in the same direction at once, so the hesitation other people carry rarely shows up in you. What it leaves out is the pause. The question worth sitting with is whether the next move gets chosen, or just taken because it was nearest.
excerpt: Two ferry tickets, bought on the walk to the dock, because your earlier plan involved a different city entirely.
